messages:
Maya: Heads-upfinalizing the marketplace iac bundle for CloudVendor listing. Need packaging checklist + tf module vetting.
Diego: Can we avoid vendor-specific names (e.g., 'cloudvendor-cluster')? Use rwd-marketplace/* for public modules.
Nina: Also need a manifest.json with marketplace metadata + a small sample output for validation. Legal asked for a brief dataflow callout.
Maya: Agreed. Proposed manifest fields: name, short_description, supported_regions, provider_constraints, required_permissions, smoke_acceptance.
Diego: Add a compatibility matrix: terraform version, provider versions, supported runtimes (hosted / dedicated / private). That helps partners choose.
Maya: I'll add a test harness scripts/marketplace_smoke.sh that does `terraform init && terraform apply -auto-approve` against an ephemeral project and then runs one inference sample.
QA-Bot: Queued job marketplace-smoke #9234 -> fmt -> tflint -> tfsec -> apply-dryrun -> full-smoke. ETA ~10m.
PartnerBot: Artifact uploaded: s3://partners-packages/marketplace-iac/marketplace-bundle-v1.0.tar.gz (sha256: b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184)
PublishBot: Reminder: marketplace listing requires: 1) 2-page support doc, 2) architecture diagram PNG, 3) security checklist. See https://wiki.redwood/marketplace-guidelines for format.
Diego: Who's drafting the security checklist? I can start a stub but need KMS/HSM + egress controls from infra side.
Nina: I'll own KMS/HSM and data residency notes. Maya, can you include logging/telemetry endpoints and opt-in instructions?
Maya: Yep. Also adding a minimal expected sample response in manifest: { "response": "ok", "token_count": 12 } and a smoke_acceptance note that inference returns JSON schema + status 200.
Diego: Nit: manifest schema should include a `smoke_acceptance.description` explaining pass criteria (infra up, inference responds, teardown succeeds).
Maya: Added that field and pushed a small branch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-iac/pull/78 (packaging + manifest + scripts). PTAL.
QA-Bot: Job #9234 completed: terraform apply simulated -> real apply against ephemeral infra succeeded -> inference smoke test PASSED. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/9234/console
PublishBot: Preflight checks passed. Next step: open a partner-review ticket for marketplace listing. @Nina can you file PART-1122 and attach manifest + logs?
Nina: On it. Ticket PART-1122 created, attachments uploaded. Link: https://issues.redwood/PART-1122
Diego: One more ask: include least-privilege IAM snippets in README and a short example of rotating keys.
Maya: Adding example IAM block to README and a `security/rotate_keys.md` note (rotate every 90 days default).
Nina: If legal asks, call out that no PII is stored and inference logs retained 7 days by default; we have an opt-in for extended retention.
Maya: Good call. Also adding diagrams/assets/marketplace-arch.png (800x500).
Diego: Can we schedule a partner demo next Wed 10am PT if docs + PR merged by EOD Tue?
Maya: Sounds good 1 I'll merge after QA signoff.
Diego: :thumbsup:
